name: Plagiarism-Checker-Pro
description: Lightweight plagiarism-detection system: upload documents, compare against each other or a pre-indexed corpus, and receive sentence-level similarity highlights.

paragraphs: A sophisticated plagiarism detection tool that compares documents, calculates similarity scores, and generates detailed, sentence-level highlight reports. Built with Python, Streamlit, advanced NLP techniques including Sentence-BERT embeddings, this application provides both corpus-wide scanning via a high-performance, pre-indexed SQLite database, and direct file-to-file comparison for quick, focused analysis.
features: Detailed Plagiarism Highlighting: Generates a sentence-by-sentence analysis and visually highlights matching sentences in the suspect document.
Advanced Text Processing: A robust pipeline that handles tokenization, lowercasing, stopword removal, and lemmatization.
